title: 第11章 少女心第12章 人赃俱获
slug: 太古神族第2477章秘境之变
lines: 听着莫阳那些话语，苏菲儿脸颊渐渐有些发红……
如此惊人的事情，莫阳居然只悄悄的告诉了她！
要知道炼丹师在整个玄天大陆上都是异常尊贵的，走到哪都会被奉为上宾。
虽然莫阳油盐不进，但此时听着莫阳这话，她心中无形中升起一种莫名的心绪。
而且她心中对莫阳充满了好奇，以往人人都说莫阳是一个废物，但如今看来，莫阳哪里是什么废物，根本就是一个天才！
莫阳身上似乎隐藏着无数秘密，整个人都像是被迷雾笼罩的一样。
只是她实在想不通，同是生活在灵虚宗，连四长老都不会的炼丹术，莫阳到底是如何学会的？
“你，你先把那丹药给我看看，若你说的是真的，我……我可以帮你！”
随着心绪波动，她说话都变得结结巴巴的，连声音也不似寻常时候那般尖锐了。
莫阳虽然感觉苏菲儿有些不对劲，但此时也没有多留意。
听苏菲儿这么说，他心中一乐，很麻溜的将驻颜丹递了过去。
还不忘低声道：“功效如何，你服用之后自然知晓，我保证你会越来越水灵漂亮！”
苏菲儿脸颊越发红了，之前莫阳曾说对她没有兴趣，她一直为此对莫阳极为不满，因为从不曾有人如此，如今听莫阳夸她水灵漂亮，心里像是什么得到了满足一样，心绪越发凌乱了。
莫阳皱了皱眉，总感觉苏菲儿有些不对劲，不过他一心想着药材，再度叮嘱道：“那我在木峰等你好消息！”
苏菲儿接过驻颜丹看都没看便将其收起来，都有些不敢去看莫阳，红着脸下意识的点了点头。
莫阳见苏菲儿点头，心中终于放心下来，随后也没有说什么，转身便朝着主峰下走去。
退到远处的主峰弟子虽然不敢靠近，但远远看去，莫阳和苏菲儿居然像是说悄悄话一样，关键是苏菲儿居然满脸羞涩，最后也不知答应了什么，竟然满脸娇羞的点头。
很多弟子感觉像是做梦一样，几乎不敢相信自己的眼睛，以往他们何曾见过苏菲儿这种模样。
直至莫阳的身影消失在视线中，齐衡才满脸阴沉的走上前来。
此时苏菲儿脸上的红晕还未完全散去，齐衡盯着山下的方向冷哼道：“苏师妹，不管莫阳说什么，你千万别去相信，他目无尊长，行事孟浪，言语轻浮，你别和他走得太近了！”
“我不知他到底得了什么机缘，让他修为成长如此之快，不过他太过阴险，你要留意！”
苏菲儿急忙收起了心绪，故作平静的点头道：“齐师兄，我知道！”
莫阳回到木峰之后，直接进入了石塔中打坐调息，随后开始尝试炼制其他寻常丹药。
“如今我的炼丹术才刚入门，必须赶紧炼制寻常丹药来熟悉，否则就算寻到那些非凡的灵药，也只会白白浪费药材。”
他在石塔中炼丹，不知时间流逝，待他离开石塔之时，外界已经天黑了。
他推开房门走到小院中，月明星稀，银白的月光笼罩着大地，此时才发现那石凳上居然坐着一个人，白裙上镶嵌的银丝在月光下闪闪发光，那黑发间斜插着的玉簪亦是被映照出缕缕光泽。
莫阳皱眉看去，发现居然是苏菲儿。
他本能的回头看了看房门，发现房门居然完好无损，院中也没有被破坏的痕迹。
content_en:
Listening to Mo Yang's words, Sophie's cheeks gradually turned red...
Mo Yang actually only told her such a shocking thing quietly!
You must know that alchemists are extremely noble in the entire Xuantian Continent, and they will be treated as honored guests wherever they go.
Although Mo Yang had no food and salt, listening to Mo Yang's words at this moment, an inexplicable emotion arose in her heart.
And she was full of curiosity about Mo Yang. In the past, everyone said that Mo Yang was a waste, but now it seems that Mo Yang is nothing but a waste, he is simply a genius!
There seemed to be countless secrets hidden in Mo Yang, and his whole person seemed to be shrouded in mist.
It’s just that she really can’t figure out how Mo Yang learned the alchemy technique that even the fourth elders don’t know, even though they live in Lingxu Sect?
"You, please show me the elixir first. If what you say is true, I...I can help you!"
As her mood fluctuated, her words became stammering, and even her voice was not as sharp as usual.
Although Mo Yang felt something was wrong with Sophie, he didn't pay much attention at this time.
Hearing what Su Feier said, he felt happy and handed the Zhuyan Pill over in a smooth manner.
He did not forget to whisper: "How effective it is, you will know after taking it. I guarantee that you will become more and more hydrated and beautiful!"
Sophie's cheeks turned redder and redder. Mo Yang had said before that he was not interested in her, and she had always been extremely dissatisfied with Mo Yang because no one had ever been like this. Now that she heard Mo Yang compliment her on her beauty, she felt as if she had been satisfied, and her mood became more and more messy.
Mo Yang frowned, always feeling that something was wrong with Sophie, but he was thinking about the medicinal materials and warned again: "Then I will wait for your good news at Mu Feng!"
Sophie took the Zhuyan Pill and put it away without looking at it. She was a little afraid to look at Mo Yang, and nodded subconsciously with a red face.
When Mo Yang saw Sophie nodding, he finally felt relieved, and then without saying anything, he turned around and walked towards the main peak.
Although the main peak disciples who had retreated far away did not dare to approach, looking from a distance, Mo Yang and Su Fei'er actually seemed to be whispering. The key was that Su Fei'er was actually shy, and in the end she nodded shyly without knowing what she agreed to.
Many disciples felt like they were in a dream and could hardly believe their eyes. They had never seen Sophie look like this before.
It wasn't until Mo Yang's figure disappeared from sight that Qi Heng stepped forward with a gloomy face.
At this time, the blush on Sophie's face had not completely dissipated. Qi Heng stared down the mountain and snorted coldly: "Junior sister Su, no matter what Mo Yang says, you must not believe it. He has no respect for his superiors, acts recklessly, and talks frivolously. Don't get too close to him!"
"I don't know what kind of opportunity he got to make his cultivation grow so fast, but he is too insidious, so you have to pay attention!"
Sophie hurriedly put away her thoughts, pretending to be calm and nodded: "Senior Brother Qi, I know!"
…
After Mo Yang returned to Mufeng, he directly entered the stone tower to meditate and adjust his breath, and then began to try to refine other ordinary elixirs.
"Now I have just started to learn alchemy. I must quickly refine ordinary elixirs to get familiar with them. Otherwise, even if I find those extraordinary elixirs, it will only be a waste of medicinal materials."
He was refining elixirs in the stone tower, unaware of the passage of time. By the time he left the stone tower, it was already dark outside.
He pushed open the door and walked into the small courtyard. The moon was sparse and the silvery moonlight shrouded the earth. Only then did he realize that there was a person sitting on the stone bench. The silver thread inlaid on the white skirt shone in the moonlight, and the hosta inserted diagonally in the black hair was also reflected in wisps of luster.
Mo Yang frowned and looked, and found that it was Sophie.
He instinctively looked back at the door and found that the door was intact and there were no signs of damage in the courtyard.
